premises.name: full-rank product linear-image density cap
premises.statement: For rank-k T and independent cap-one inputs, ||p_TX||_infinity <= 2^(k/2)/sqrt(det(TT^T)).

premises.name: latest partner bilateral rank-three compiler
premises.statement: account02/B01 r36 gives ||p_Q||_infinity <=6(sigma1 sigma2 sigma3)^(-1/3) for an exact rank-three physical cross block with arbitrary same-bank curvature.

new_result.statement: For Q=U^T C U+2U^T(MY+c)+R(Y) with k=3 original physical hub coordinates U, independent cap-one physical inputs, arbitrary C,c,R, and rank(M)=3, D=det(MM^T)>0, |phi_Q(t)|<=min(1,2^(3/4)pi^(3/2)D^(-1/4)|t|^(-3/2)); hence Q has a continuous density with ||p_Q||_infinity<=3sqrt(2)D^(-1/6). More generally k>=3 gives sqrt(2) k/(k-2) D^(-1/(2k)).
new_result.structural_identity: det(A[H,H^c]A[H^c,H])=sum_{T subset H^c, |T|=3}det(A[H,T])^2 for each physical triple H.

partner_application.actual_inequality: For A_m=[[0,M_m],[M_m^T,0]] with M_m M_m^T=I3, partner r36 gives ||p||_infinity<=6; this run improves the same concrete target-valid family to ||p||_infinity<=3sqrt(2). Partner r35 also gives H_1/2<=2^(11/4) after selecting two of the three physical hubs.

unresolved_implication: QFORM-EXTERIOR3-OVERLAP-ROUTING-v1: from e3(A^2)>=1, spend the overlap classes of the full physical 3-minor energy by original-coordinate aggregate mechanisms. The r=0 disjoint component can use balanced cross-minor or fixed-three-hub compilers; r=1,2,3 still need correction-safe original-product routing without choosing a tiny minor or a worst projected fiber.
next_step: Derive exact determinant/Schur identities for intersection sizes 1 and 2 and test whether their aggregate sums can be fed directly into existing scalar-pivot E2 and two-hub half-Riesz currencies without a dimension-losing coordinate maximum.
